hero.title: Your Construction Project, Under Total Control.
hero.subtitle: Geme is the complete platform for construction project management. Centralize documentation, track progress, and manage your teams, all in real time.

features.title: One Platform, Absolute Control
features.subtitle: Powerful tools for every specialist and every phase of your project.

wbs.title: Planning & Control (WBS)
wbs.description: Create Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Gantt charts, baselines, and control physical progress.

eva.title: Financial Control (EVA)
eva.description: Manage budgets, actual costs, and analyze project performance with Earned Value Analysis (EVA).

revisions.title: Document Revision Control
revisions.description: Manage the version history of drawings and specifications, ensuring your team always uses the correct information.

requirements.title: Requirements Management
requirements.description: Document, track, and validate all technical and functional requirements, linking them to quality tests.

changes.title: Change Management
changes.description: Formalize and control all scope changes with a clear and traceable approval workflow.

dailyReport.title: Digital Work Log
dailyReport.description: Record daily progress, manpower, equipment, and occurrences with photos and automatic reports.

risks.title: Risk Analysis
risks.description: Identify, assess, and create mitigation plans for project risks, with AI-powered analysis support.

clientPortal.title: Client Portal
clientPortal.description: Offer your clients a transparent view of the work's progress, with controlled access to reports.

clientPortal.title: Total Transparency for Those Who Invest
clientPortal.subtitle: Offer your clients a window into project progress, with controlled access, simplified reports, and a formal communication channel to increase trust.

feature1.title: Intuitive Dashboards
feature1.description: Clear view of physical and financial progress, and site photographs.

feature2.title: Centralized Communication
feature2.description: A direct channel for approvals, requests, and questions, all duly recorded.

finalCta.title: Start Transforming Your Construction Management Today
finalCta.subtitle: Join hundreds of professionals who are already building smarter.

pricing.title: Plans and Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start for free and scale as you need. No surprises.

hobby.title: Hobby
hobby.description: For small projects or personal use.

pro.title: Professional
pro.description: For teams and companies managing multiple works.
